Sometime between [[3973 BBY]] and [[3965 BBY]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the conflict known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] '''invaded''' the [[Kaelta system]], having [[Battle of the Quermia system|captured]] the [[Quermia system/Legends|Quermia system]] previously. From the Kaelta system, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Battle of the Florn system|raided]] the [[Florn system/Legends|Florn system]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the course of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose. In the ''Atlas'', the Kaelta system is denoted as the "Toola system"<ref name="Atlas" /> after the planet of [[Toola/Legends|Toola]], which it contains.
